header.title: PGM LXXVII: Oracle request: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Papyri Graecae Magicae
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:magic:dclp:63392:grc, from papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (CC BY 3.0), one English line for each line of the original. notes.3: Dotted letters in the edition (e.g. in ὄρη, σελήνη, θρόνος) are doubtful readings. ‘The one who in the middle part of the field is seated’ renders odd Greek (τὸν μέσον μέρος ἀρούρης καθήμενον). κωμαστήριον, ‘place of revel’, is a hall for processions. Lines 15–16 are magical words with gaps of about 11 and 8 letters.

nodes.text: in your mind, uttering nothing aloud:
I call upon the one who in the middle
part of the field is seated,
all things, before whom the *daimones* [spirits] tremble,
and the clear upper air his place of revel,
and the earth his footstool: iou iou
